description:
Generate packaging artwork from one of your saved Design Studio designs.

This personalizes a template you already authored: it rewrites that design's
named text and image placeholders. It cannot author a design from scratch, and
the artwork it produces is NOT attached to a product — Roastify's API has no
product-create or storefront-sync surface. You get an artwork URL and carry it
onward yourself.

Roastify renders asynchronously, so this returns a job id straight away. Check
it with roastify_artwork_status, which is free.

client_req_id.description:
Your own idempotency key. Reusing it makes a repeated
request safe — Roastify will not generate the artwork twice.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

fields.description:
Placeholders to rewrite, each
{"fieldId": "placeholder_title", "type": "text"|"image",
 "value": "..."}. An image value must be an https:// URL.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

product_id.description: A saved design's id, from list_my_products.

name: roastify_generate_artwork
title: Generate artwork
